summary: Rendering compositing setup. Chooses an alpha value from a4 flags: when a4[6] has bit 0x800 set and a4[13] is non-zero the alpha becomes a4[13] | 0xFF000000; when (unk_800000 & a4[6]) is set a labeled path is taken; otherwise alpha defaults to -65281. Locks the source via LockUnlockWrapper (error into this+0x0, returning -1 on failure), optionally fills the destination surface fields and calls sub_55C450 and sub_53F720 when a6 is null. Selects the output surface by the a5 flag value (4 or 8 use vtable slot +60 of v6[4]/v6[5]; 1 and 2 use v6[2]/v6[3]), then performs the compositing blit via sub_5008E4 and releases the surface for the 4/8 cases. Returns 0 on success, -1 on any failure.

operations.description: Initialize alpha to 0 and read the flag word v7 = a4[6].
If bit 0x800 of a4[6] is set and a4[13] is non-zero, use alpha = a4[13] | 0xFF000000 and continue at the lock step.
Else if the global unk_800000 bit is set in a4[6], take the same labeled path (alpha already chosen path).
Default alpha value when neither flag path applies: v19 = -65281.
Lock the source via LockUnlockWrapper(a2, a3, v20) and store the result into this+0x0.
If the lock result in this+0x0 is non-zero, return -1 (failure).
When a6 is null: copy fields from the locked data v20 into the surface v6 (v6[6], v6[7], v6[8]) and query format/size via sub_55C450(v20[4], v6+9, v6+12).
When a6 is null, call sub_53F720(this, v6, v6[11]); return -1 if it reports failure.
When mode a5 == 4, dispatch vtable slot +60 of the surface object v6[4], store the result into this+0x0 and return -1 on failure.
When mode a5 == 8, dispatch vtable slot +60 of the surface object v6[5], store the result into this+0x0 and return -1 on failure.
When bit 0x1 of mode a5 is set, select the destination surface a4 = v6[2].
When bit 0x2 of mode a5 is set, select the destination surface a4 = v6[3].
Perform the compositing blit: sub_5008E4(a4, 0, 0, a2, a3, 0, 1, v19, v20); store the result into this+0x0 and return -1 on failure.
For modes 4 or 8, release the surface by dispatching vtable slot +8 of the destination a4.
Return 0 on success; every failure path returns -1.

clean_pseudocode: if (a5 == 4) { this[0] = vtable60(v6[4], a6, &a4); if (this[0]) return -1; }
else if (a5 == 8) { this[0] = vtable60(v6[5], a6, &a4); if (this[0]) return -1; }
